items.title: Bessent believes there won't be a recession in 2026 but says some sectors are challenged
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. was not at risk of entering a recession in 2026 and that Americans would soon benefit from Trump's policies.

items.title: Industry at the heart of international solutions: UN summit opens in Riyadh
items.summary: Leaders from across the world are debating how industry can help tackle some of the world’s most urgent challenges – from climate change and food insecurity to the need for fairer supply chains – at the Global Industry Summit, which opened on Sunday in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
